items.source: If this method returns false, the methods on the given class will not get traversed for getCacheOperation(Method, Class) introspection. Returning false is therefore an optimization for non-affected classes, whereas true simply means that the class needs to get fully introspected for each method on the given class individually.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `false`，则不会针对给定类上的方法执行 `getCacheOperation(Method, Class)` 内省。因此，返回 `false` 是对不受影响类的优化，而返回 `true` 仅意味着需要针对给定类上的每个方法单独进行完全内省。

items.source: Interface used by JCacheInterceptor. Implementations know how to source cache operation attributes from standard JSR-107 annotations.
items.translation: 由 `JCacheInterceptor` 使用的接口。实现类知道如何从标准的 JSR-107 注解中获取缓存操作属性。

items.source: Return the cache operations for this method, or null if the method contains no JSR-107 related metadata.
items.translation: 返回此方法的缓存操作，或者如果该方法不包含任何JSR-107相关元数据，则返回`null`。

items.source: Determine whether there is a JSR-107 cache operation for the given method.
items.translation: 确定给定方法是否存在 JSR-107 缓存操作。

items.source: targetClass - the target class (can be null, in which case the declaring class of the method must be used)
items.translation: targetClass - 目标类（可以为 null，在这种情况下，必须使用方法的声明类）

items.source: Determine whether the given class is a candidate for cache operations in the metadata format of this JCacheOperationSource.
items.translation: 确定给定类是否为该 `JCacheOperationSource` 元数据格式中缓存操作的候选项。

items.source: false if the class is known to have no cache operation metadata at class or method level; true otherwise. The default implementation returns true, leading to regular introspection.
items.translation: 如果已知该类在类或方法级别没有缓存操作元数据，则返回`false`；否则返回`true`。默认实现返回`true`，从而进行常规内省。

items.source: the cache operation for this method, or null if none found
items.translation: 此方法的缓存操作，或如果未找到则返回null。
